mapper.insert: INSERT INTO api_test_runs (id, environment, total, passed, failed, duration_ms, ok, message, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{environment}, #{total}, #{passed}, #{failed}, #{durationMs}, #{ok}, #{message}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt})

INSERT INTO api_test_run_cases (id, run_id, case_id, name, method, path, url, status, http_status, duration_ms, error, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{runId}, #{caseId}, #{name}, #{method}, #{path}, #{url}, #{status}, #{httpStatus}, #{durationMs}, #{error}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, run_id AS runId, case_id AS caseId, name, method, path, url, status, http_status AS httpStatus, duration_ms AS durationMs, error, created_at AS createdAt FROM api_test_run_cases ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM api_test_cases WHERE created_at >= #{since}

SELECT COUNT(1) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'PASSED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS passed, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed, AVG(duration_ms) AS avgLatencyMs FROM api_test_run_cases WHERE created_at >= #{since}
AND created_at < #{until}

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(c.project), ''), '(未分组)') AS project, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS caseCount, COUNT(r.id) AS runCount, SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'PASSED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS passed, SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed FROM api_test_cases c LEFT JOIN api_test_run_cases r ON r.case_id = c.id AND r.created_at >= #{since} GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(c.project), ''), '(未分组)') ORDER BY caseCount DESC, project ASC
